plain_control: primitive odd Conrey(13,2), single Euler-product L-function restricted to real parity sectors; symmetrized log derivative, not H13,2 mixture
fit: least-squares log(lambda_min(C)) against C, primary N128 each parity and global minimum; report adjacent slopes, N96 sensitivity, lambda_2 and lambda_3 slopes. No fitted value is a theorem.
forecast_rule: C_pred(b)=1373/32+(2/kappa13)*log((1/250)/b), with kappa13 measured by the primary finite-control global-ground fit; no new mixture windows or parameter selection until fixed forecast file exists.
scope: One conductor and normalization; same-height and gamma effects and retained-family bias may invalidate the proposed mechanism.
